comparison.objective: PR-2052 sets and locks a jigsaw shoe at a 45° bevel; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop at 90° and verifies retained motion.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2052 requires releasing a lever, sliding off a positive stop, tilting through detents, and reclamping; the candidate requires simultaneous coaxial driver and thin-wrench countertorque on a screw/jam-nut pair.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2052 requires a hands-off 45° shoe with its lever clamped and stable under a push; the candidate additionally requires both nuts retained and three close-open cycles returning within tolerance and drift limits.
comparison.reason: This is the closest objective-level match, but the locking mechanism and core tested ability differ meaningfully: detent-and-lever repositioning versus preserving a threaded adjustment against tightening reaction and proving cyclic retention.
